content.comment_body: Regarding using AWS Cloud, is it possible to connect via the [product_name] simulator rather than the actual [product_name] hardware? This would make testing simpler. Thank you for any insights.
To summarize: No. The [product_name] simulation software does not support communication with AWS Cloud when running in simulation mode.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are interested in using the [product_name] simulation tool to test cloud integration with AWS, aiming for easier validation and development before deploying physical hardware. The feedback indicates that simulation mode does not allow AWS Cloud connectivity, revealing a restriction in the software and pointing out a gap between current capabilities and user expectations for hardware-free, cloud-based testing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to connect the [product_name] simulation environment to AWS Cloud, enabling streamlined and faster testing of cloud integration features without depending on actual hardware.
